name: Orchestrator Extension for Alteon Load Balancer
description: The Alteon Load Balancer integration allows you to manage certificates on a Radware Alteon Load Balancer appliance, including binding certificates to virtual services for SSL termination.

store_types.Name: Alteon Load Balancer
store_types.ClientMachineDescription: The hostname or IP address of the Alteon Load Balancer device (example: https://alteonlb.test.com).

EntryParameters.Name: VirtualServiceBindings
EntryParameters.Description: Comma-separated list of virtual service bindings in 'virtId:servicePort' format. Each binding identifies the virtual server ID and the service port to which the certificate should be bound. Example: '1:443' for a single binding, or '1:443,2:443,my-virt:8443' for multiple bindings. Returned during inventory to show which virtual services each certificate is currently bound to.
